Any visible light is ONLY the original single fine outer 270degree track (upper-left quarter dark); crop most of ring if necessary but do not add luminous inner rings, star glyphs or border lights.
Natural premium 50mm cinema lens, diagonal from A right hand through sword tip to near floor and narrow slot to make cause and route legible, enough depth of field to read contact and threshold, realistic old steel/skin/fabric/maintained finely cut grey stone; no blanket rust/pitted decay, low saturation dawn and blue interior.
